description: If an arithmetic theory \(T\supseteq Q\) is consistent, no arithmetic formula \(A(x)\) has \(T\)-proofs of all biconditionals \(A(\overline{\ulcorner\sigma\urcorner})\leftrightarrow\sigma\) as \(\sigma\) ranges over arithmetic sentences. No assumption that \(T\) is computably enumerable or sound in \(\mathbb N\) is required.
